name: gaotus-appforge-mvp
description: Gaotus AppForge master wrapper MVP for Android and iOS

scripts.native:init: npm run generate && npx cap add android && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs all
scripts.android:debug: npm run generate && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run generate && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run generate && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs ios
